challenges.title: SIA licensing, night work and many sites

items.title: Keeping SIA licensing requirements under control
items.text: The Private Security Industry Act 2001 and SIA regulation require a valid licence for most roles — tedious to check by hand across many staff and sites.

items.title: Identifying night workers & health assessments
items.text: Anyone who regularly works at least 3 hours between 11pm and 6am counts as a "night worker" under the Working Time Regulations and is entitled to a free health assessment — easy to miss with rotating patrols.

items.title: Many sites, one plan
items.text: Every site has its own posts, hours and requirements — keeping track of it all by hand is barely feasible.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off security providers in the UK
solutions.subtitle: From covered posts to valid SIA licences — everything works together.

items.title: Sites & posts with no gaps
items.text: Every post across every site — Klacks shows every open slot immediately and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: SIA licence matched automatically, expiry in view
items.text: Klacks only assigns shifts to staff with the matching SIA licence qualification — and warns before a licence on file expires.

items.title: Night workers identified automatically
items.text: Klacks automatically identifies who counts as a "night worker" under the Working Time Regulations — the basis for triggering the statutory health assessment in good time.

items.title: Patrols optimised

items.title: On-premise: data sovereignty
